<h1 class="entry-title">Ordinary Council Meeting – 18 June 2025</h1>		<div class="entry-meta">
              <span class="posted-on">Posted on <a href="https://www.kent.wa.gov.au/council/agendas-minutes/ordinary-council-meeting-18-june-2025/" rel="bookmark"><time class="entry-date published" datetime="2025-06-13T16:03:24+08:00">13 June 2025</time><time class="updated  screen-reader-text" datetime="2025-06-19T10:01:59+08:00">19 June 2025</time></a></span>		</div><!-- .entry-meta -->

	</div><!-- .entry-header -->

	<div class="entry-content">

		<div class="thumbnail">
					</div>

		<div class="post-preview">
			<h2>Agenda</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.kent.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Agenda-Ordinary-Council-Meeting-18-June-2025.pdf">Agenda – Ordinary Council Meeting 18 June 2025</a></p>
<h2>Minutes</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.kent.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Unconfirmed-Minutes-Ordinary-Council-Meeting-18-June-2025.pdf">Unconfirmed Minutes – Ordinary Council Meeting 18 June 2025</a></p>
<h2>Attachments</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.kent.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Attachment-6.2-Outstanding-Council-Resolutions-Register-June-2025.pdf">6.2 Attachment 1 – Outstanding Council Resolutions June 2025</a></p>
<p><a href="https://www.kent.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/9.4-Attachment-1-Draft-Memorandum-of-Understanding.pdf">9.4 Attachment 1 – Draft Memorandum of Understanding</a></p>
<p><a href="https://www.kent.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/9.6-Attachment-1-Monthly-Financial-Report-to-31-May-2025.pdf">9.6 Attachment 1 – Monthly Financial Report to 31 May 2025</a></p>
<p><a href="https://www.kent.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/9.7-Attachment-1-Schedule-of-Accounts-Paid-May-2025.pdf">9.7 Attachment 1 – Schedule of Accounts Paid – May 2025</a></p>
<h2>Audio Recording</h2>
<p><span lang="EN-US">For the Ordinary Council Meeting held on 18 June 2025, it was not possible for a recording of the meeting to be made by means of the local government’s recording technology. The platform that the Shire of Kent uses to record meetings is web based, and the Shire’s cyber security programs prevented access to the site as it falsely identified it as a trojan site. Overrides were not possible as IT Support was not immediately available at the time of the issue.</span></p>
<p><span lang="EN-US">No improvised recording was made of the meeting as it was not reasonably practicable for the local government to make an improvised recording. Previous testing of using a mobile phone to record the meeting in the Council Chambers has showed that using such a method would not satisfy the quality requirements outlined in regulation 14I(2)(c) of the <em>Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</em>.</span></p>
